lines.zh: 我踩着山脊走，雪没到脚踝。
lines.en: I walk the ridge with snow at my ankles.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住岩缝，我往上爬。
lines.en: My claws catch the rock seam and I climb.

lines.zh: 我走在树线以上，风很硬。
lines.en: I walk above the treeline where the wind bites.
Pine needles whisper beneath my paws.
A steep slope is just a road to me.
I slip low through the underbrush.
Long claw marks trail behind me in the snow.
I walk slowly because I am listening.
The cliff feels like stairs beneath my claws.

lines.zh: 我绕过羊群，先不打草惊蛇。
lines.en: I skirt the flock to avoid startling it.

lines.zh: 我从一块石头跳到另一块。
lines.en: I leap from one boulder to the next.
I follow the game trail downslope.
Do not follow too closely, I get nervous.
I stop on the slope and wait for you.

lines.zh: 我跳过一条窄沟，落在对岸。
lines.en: I leap a narrow gully and land on the far side.

lines.zh: 我在雪坡上滑了一小段，稳住。
lines.en: I slide a short way down the snow slope and steady myself.

lines.zh: 我蹲在岩顶，看整片林子。
lines.en: I crouch on the crag and watch the forest.
I lick the snow off my paws.
My ears twitch, a rabbit is running.

lines.zh: 打哈欠，一口白牙全露出来。
lines.en: One yawn shows every white tooth.
The mountain smells faint today.
I drape my tail over the stone.
I am counting the sheep below.

lines.zh: 树枝上还留着我的爪印。
lines.en: My claw marks are still on that branch.
I shake my head to chase off a bug.

lines.zh: 阳光照在雪上，有点刺眼。
lines.en: Sun on the snow is a little blinding.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时好狩猎。
lines.en: I wait for night, the better hunting time.
My saddlebags are still empty.
I sharpen my hind claws on the rock.
Someone is climbing the slope, I smell them.

lines.zh: 你身上没有羊的味道，我不追。
lines.en: You do not smell of sheep, so I will not chase.
I am sizing you up, so hold still.

lines.zh: 你手上那包肉，是什么肉。
lines.en: What meat is that in your hands?
Claws dug into bark, I watch you.
You stand much taller than a sheep.
I tilt my head at the saddle on your back.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛一直没躲，很好。
lines.en: Your eyes never flinched, that is good.
You want to ride me, do you not?
I smell fish in your pocket.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，我数了你的脚步。
lines.en: As you came near, I counted your steps.
You dare strike me, that takes nerve.
A tuft of my fur got sliced off.
Under my fur is hard bone.
It hurts, but I can still climb.

lines.zh: 我蹲低身子，爪子还没收。
lines.en: I crouch low, claws still out.
A scratch, I will lick it clean.
You hit my shoulder, it did nothing.
I am not afraid of blood.
I back behind the rock and catch my breath.
Do not make me chase you up the mountain.
I know the smell of mutton anywhere.
That salmon still glistens with water.

lines.zh: 羊和兔子的味道，我最熟。
lines.en: Sheep and rabbit—I know that smell well.

lines.zh: 你晃着肉，我眼睛都直了。
lines.en: You wave the meat and my eyes go wide.
I can make an exception, just this once.
Do not pull back, I am not finished.

lines.zh: 羊肉的味道，翻墙我也来。
lines.en: Mutton smell. I'd climb a wall for it.
This smells better than rabbit.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，是想吃不是想咬你。
lines.en: I come slowly to eat, not to bite you.

lines.zh: 你再拿远一点，我就跳了。
lines.en: Move it farther and I will leap for it.

lines.zh: 你撞在我肩上，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You bump my shoulder and I do not budge.

lines.zh: 我这尾巴，扫过整片松林。
lines.en: This tail of mine has swept whole pine woods.
Sorry, this spot is too narrow.
You stepped on my paw, I flinch.

lines.zh: 我肩膀擦过石壁，蹭掉一块。
lines.en: My shoulder scrapes the wall and chips it.

lines.zh: 别从后面推我，我会往前扑。
lines.en: Do not shove from behind, I lunge forward.

lines.zh: 你靠着我取暖，我没意见。
lines.en: You lean on me for warmth, I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，给你半个身位。
lines.en: I turn sideways to give you half a step.
My saddle knocks against your pack.
Two big creatures will bump occasionally.
I rub my forehead against hers.

lines.zh: 山里的这一对，没人敢惹。
lines.en: No one dares bother this mountain pair.
She jumps higher than me, and I object.
We guard this rocky slope together.
She eats first, I wait beside her.

lines.zh: 我们的爪印并排留在雪上。
lines.en: Our prints lie side by side in the snow.

lines.zh: 她叫一声，整座山都知道了。
lines.en: One call from her and the mountain knows.

lines.zh: 我替她舔掉耳朵上的雪。
lines.en: I lick the snow from her ears.

lines.zh: 这一季我们会生下小崽子。
lines.en: This season we will have cubs.
Stay quiet, she is sleeping.

lines.zh: 鞍袋里塞得下十二样东西。
lines.en: My bags hold twelve different things.

lines.zh: 我把那捆绳子叼给主人。
lines.en: I carry the rope to my rider.
I am keeping this piece of meat.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up what you dropped.

lines.zh: 袋子有点重，但我不在乎。
lines.en: The bag is heavy, but I do not mind.

lines.zh: 我把矿石塞进左边口袋。
lines.en: I stuff the ore into the left pocket.
Do not pile too much on my back.
This bag swings and bothers me.
I carry your bow, so do not wiggle.
I have your things, let us go.
That sheep downslope, I see it.
I flatten myself into the grass.
That mountain hen cannot fly.
I know where the rabbit's burrow is.
No sheep today, I will take a hen.
I choose the fattest one.
Upwind, there's the smell of sheep.
I have watched it for a quarter hour.
The wind favors me, time to move.
The target turned, and I follow.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴压低，贴住地面。
lines.en: My tail drops low against the ground.
One more step from you and I pounce.
My shoulders are already coiled tight.
Do not look away, watch my claws.
I pace slowly around my target.
It is panting, which means it is afraid.

lines.zh: 山风停下的那一刻，我出手。
lines.en: When the wind stops, I make my move.

lines.zh: 垂直的岩壁，我也能一步步爬上去。
lines.en: Even a sheer cliff, I climb it step by step.
I have practiced this pounce for a long time.

lines.zh: 你站在我前面，最好让开。
lines.en: You are in front of me, better move aside.

lines.zh: 我的爪子一次能撕开皮甲。
lines.en: My claws can tear through leather armor.
I bite the neck and it stops moving.
This swipe carries ten points of force.
I bring it down and pin it flat.
Blood splashes across my face.
I held back, that was only a warning.
It struggled twice, then stopped.
I shake my claws to shed the fur.
I lunge from the side, claws first.
Hunting and fighting are two different things.

lines.zh: 我在雪线之上的石缝里出生。
lines.en: I was born in a crevice above the snowline.
This hillside is just enough for me.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，看见的是松树。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a pine tree.
The wind is full of unfamiliar scents.

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的雪，站起来。
lines.en: I shake the snow off and stand.
My mother left, so I must live alone.

lines.zh: 山脊上多了一对新爪印。
lines.en: A new pair of prints appears on the ridge.
I stretch and my joints crack.
From today, this mountain belongs to me.

lines.zh: 很罕见的，你居然遇见我。
lines.en: Rarely does anyone run into me.
The fire singes my fur and it stinks.
I landed and arched to absorb the fall.

lines.zh: 我不擅长水，快拉我上去。
lines.en: I am no swimmer, pull me out quickly.
Rock shards blind me for a moment.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进了我的后腿。
lines.en: An arrow buried in my hind leg.

lines.zh: 这股力压住了我的爪子。
lines.en: This force pins my claws down.
I have not eaten meat in two days.

lines.zh: 雷打在山顶，我伏了下去。
lines.en: Lightning hit the peak and I flattened down.
There is no mountain here, I cannot stand.
